notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) evaluating Hosted API with intent to move to Dedicated for production. Product: in-app assistant for power users + customer support routing + semantic search across docs.
- Trial + POC focused on proving latency & cost at scale; now evaluating Dedicated sizing and pricing.

Hosted API trial findings (quantified):
- Trial duration: 2026-01-28 -> ongoing (trial credit exhausted early Feb but resumed after top-up).
- Peak QPS observed in spike tests: ~48 QPS (10s windows). Sustained during trial: 10-15 QPS.
- Typical concurrency observed at Hosted endpoints: 40-90 concurrent requests per model across multi-tenant tests (avg ~65).
- Token mix (derived from sample traces): avg 820 tokens per call (input ~320, output ~500). 60% of calls are short-turn conversational (<=300 tokens), 40% are long summaries or multi-doc synth (800-2,400 tokens).
- Request distribution: 70% user-facing interactive (latency-sensitive), 30% async batch (embeddings + nightly re-rank).
- 95th pct latency target for interactive flows: <=350ms server-to-server (customer expects end-to-end <600ms).
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.015 per 1K tokens in steady-state to meet product economics.

Dedicated sizing ask (from SE workshop):
- Baseline forecast (Q3 launch): avg 18 QPS sustained, 55 QPS peaks, concurrency 120+ across multiple routes.
- Token consumption forecast: 18 QPS * 3600s * 820 tokens * 30 days ~ 1.6B tokens/month (approx).
- Redwood SE preliminary sizing: 3-5 high-memory accelerators (NVIDIA A100 / similar) depending on kernel/quantization. Consider mixed pool for short-chat vs long-gen.
- Requested features: autoscale burst to public capacity, tenant isolation, per-route cost metrics in Console.

Security/ops notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) and audit logging for all calls. Data residency preference: US only initially. KMS integration required for key management.
- VPC peering required for Dedicated; need diagram for networking and egress IP list.

Stakeholder quotes / shorthand:
- Head of Product: "We need predictable per-session cost before committing to Dedicated."
- Infra lead: "Can you show expected concurrency behavior under 5% error budget?"

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to produce 2 capacity options (conservative / aggressive) with cost delta and throughput assumptions by 2026-03-17.
- Procurement to confirm budget window and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs annual).
- SE to run focused latency test on dedicated staging once sizing agreed.
